hold.title: Total amount on hold
hold.hint: Money TikTok has NOT settled yet: Σ estimated settlement amount (est_settlement_amount) of unsettled transactions (Finance API). Current snapshot, not tied to the date range. Other currencies are listed separately, never converted.

shop.title: Shop status
shop.hint: Based on the TikTok shop status stored in the system: Live = ACTIVE; Die = INACTIVE (reported inactive by TikTok); Deauthorized = DEAUTHORIZED.

holdBySeller.title: On hold by seller
holdBySeller.hint: Hold grouped by the seller assigned to the TikTok account. Shop = shops with unsettled money. Every seller with a hold, descending.

period.title: Orders by period
period.hint: Orders placed in the period (operations time zone). Est. Rev = proceeds of those orders (settled, otherwise TikTok estimate). Payout = money TikTok paid out in the period. % versus the previous period.
period.noBaseline: No orders in the previous period — % not available

finance.title: Finance
finance.hint: Paid = money TikTok paid out (PAID payments) in the range. Processing = settled statements whose payment is still PROCESSING.

orders.title: Orders
orders.returnsUnavailable: TikTok Return & Refund is not synced yet, so there are no return figures.

sellers.title: Seller statistics
sellers.hint: Seller = employee assigned as seller of a TikTok account. Uses the shared date range and filters; On hold is the current snapshot.
sellers.returnsUnavailable: No return data yet (requires TikTok Return & Refund integration).

colHint.estRevenue: Order proceeds: settled amount, otherwise TikTok estimate.
colHint.revenue: Amount paid by buyers (GMV), excluding cancelled orders.
colHint.baseCost: Product cost confirmed by the fulfillment provider (current attempt).
colHint.profit: PF = Est. revenue − Base cost. Orders without a confirmed base cost count as 0 cost.
colHint.paid: Money TikTok paid out in the range.
colHint.processing: Settled but not paid out yet (payment PROCESSING).
colHint.hold: Money TikTok has not settled yet (current).
